title: admitMemberEnterpriseInput
description: The request admit-member-enterprise.mjs reads via --request or stdin: proposing one member enterprise onto the pool's pending roster.

enterpriseId.description: Legal or trade name and contact, used as the roster key.

offer.description: A one-sentence receiver/offer/price statement, no identity framing.

reportingCommitment.description: The cadence and shape of receipts the enterprise posts to disclosure.

sponsorEnterprise.description: An already-admitted enterprise vouching for it; required unless allowUnsponsored is true.

allowUnsponsored.description: True only for the org's own first-roster seed.
